name: Paul Sun-Hyung Lee
bio: Paul Sun-Hyung Lee (Korean: 이선형; born August 16, 1972) is a Canadian-South Korean actor. He is best known for his roles as Randy Ko in the soap opera Train 48 (2003–2005) and as family patriarch Appa in the play Kim's Convenience (2011) and its television adaptation (2016–2021).
